manifest.description: Extract a contiguous slice of a `with` block's clauses into a separate function returning {:ok, _} | {:error, _} via elixir_with_clause_extract.
when_to_use: a with block has a cohesive prefix or suffix that's a candidate for naming/reuse
the extracted slice has a clean ok/error contract that compresses parent semantics
anti_patterns: do not use when the with block has non-trivial else arms unless acknowledge_else_arm_residue=true
do not use to extract a middle slice that introduces bindings used in both pre- and post-slices (v1 doesn't track that)

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-with-clause-extract.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_with_clause_extract", source="{{source}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={"anchor_line": {{anchor_line}}, "anchor_column": {{anchor_column}}, "extract_start_clause": {{extract_start_clause}}, "extract_end_clause": {{extract_end_clause}}, "acknowledge_else_arm_residue": {{acknowledge_else_arm_residue}}}).
2. Refuse on no_with_block / range_inverted / range_out_of_bounds / else_arm_residue.
3. Apply with mix compile + test.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<clause_count + extracted clauses + has_else_arm>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{module_name}} {{anchor_line}} {{anchor_column}} {{extract_start_clause}} {{extract_end_clause}} {{acknowledge_else_arm_residue}} {{apply}}
